title: delphinium halteratum subsp. verdunense
intro: Delphinium halteratum subsp. verdunense, commonly known as the Verdun delphinium, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Ranunculaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Delphinium halteratum subsp. verdunense include acting as a sedative, antispasmodic, and expectorant, helping to relieve pain, reduce inflammation, and facilitate the removal of mucus from the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
